object.attr: The design shows the disk size of stored data. 1 KB is 1024 bytes. The code measures only the main database file today, once when the screen opens, so recent data held in the companion files is left out. Basis: design handoff.
object.description: When the Settings screen opens, the app shall show the combined size of the workout database files in bytes below 1 KB, in KB below 1 MB and in MB from 1 MB upward.
